name: @frontline/desktop
description: Command center for running several ecommerce stores with AI agent squads.
author: Frontline Ecom

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main.js && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload.cjs
scripts.package: pnpm --filter @frontline/web build && pnpm build && node scripts/stage.mjs && electron-builder --win
